name: Omoi, Tokihanatareta Toki
original_name: 想い、解き放たれたとき
source:
Main character is a sophomore student. His father remarries, and protagonist's classmate girl becomes his new sister. With new mother, new sister and a cute childhood friend his summer is approaching it height.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]

The main interesting feature of this game is that the new stepmother/oneesan character is customisable in many ways - hairstyle, haircolor, breastsize, tan pattern, etc.
